record.question: Which one of the following is not true of Mir Kasim?
options: He was the successor of Siraj-ud-daula
He transferred his capital from Murshidabad to Monghyrs
He signed treaty with Company in 1760
The Battle of Buxar broke out during his regime
record.explanation: Mir Kasim was not the immediate successor of Siraj-ud-daula.
